name: Goldman Sachs
coverage: Selected India exposure: six listed-company records through the client-managed India Equity Portfolio and two private/India-linked investment relationships. Named holder, reporting date and evidence quality remain visible.
limitations: Selective public records, not a complete Goldman Sachs portfolio, beneficial-ownership register or real-time exposure report.
Managed-fund holdings and Alternatives investments are distinct. None of these records establishes that the position is financed solely with Goldman Sachs proprietary capital.

Listed percentages are secondary transcriptions: five September 2026 records and one historical June 2026 record. Original exchange filings could not be retrieved; these figures remain reported, not independently reconciled.
Review date is not ownership date. Missing percentages remain unknown; absence from a public disclosure does not establish an exit.
Portfolio weights, investee-company stakes, financing round sizes and investment-banking mandates are different measures and are not combined.

report.title: Goldman Sachs · Indian exposure
report.summary: Two investment routes: client-managed listed equities and separate private-market strategies. Eight selected records retain the named holder, ownership date and source qualification; no group-wide stake or total portfolio value is calculated.

sections.title: Listed equities · client-managed fund
sections.text: The six public-company records are attributed to Goldman Sachs Funds – Goldman Sachs India Equity Portfolio. Percentages measure the named fund’s stake in each company, not the company’s weight inside the fund. Third-party tables transcribe the disclosures; original filings were unavailable for reconciliation.

sections.title: Private investments · separate strategies
sections.text: MoEngage’s November 2025 announcement identifies Goldman Sachs Alternatives as an existing investor in its financing. Aragen’s January 2025 announcement confirms an older strategic investment relationship. Neither provides a current retained percentage. These are not positions in the listed India Equity Portfolio.

sections.title: Advisory work is not equity exposure
sections.text: Goldman Sachs operates banking, trading and asset-management businesses in India. An IPO or acquisition advisory mandate, analyst coverage or a client execution trade is not evidence of proprietary company ownership. This profile includes investment records rather than advisory clients.

themes.name: Listed-company exposure
themes.case: The selected records span finance, technology, industrial components and healthcare services. Holdings alone do not reveal the manager’s investment rationale.
themes.watch: Subsequent quarterly disclosures, exact legal holder and original filing reconciliation.

themes.name: Specialist private-market businesses
themes.case: MoEngage and Aragen provide examples of software and life-sciences investment relationships. They do not establish a comprehensive private portfolio or a future deal pipeline.
themes.watch: Later financing, dilution, secondary sales and explicit ownership disclosures.
